attributes.claim: Added the AppliedIncentive resource (queryable using Search and SearchStream ) to provide redemption details.
Added new error codes in IncentiveError and AuthenticationError.INVALID_EMAIL_ADDRESS .
Added CustomerUserAccess.pending_multi_party_auth_review to link to a pending review.
Added support for Facebook Messenger and Zalo as providers.
